knowledge_point.title: Evaluating an Expression Using the Quotient Rule

question.:question/worked-solution:
First, let's recall the quotient rule for logarithms:

$$
\log_{n}\left(a\right)-\log_{n}\left(b\right)=\log_{n}\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)
$$

Using the quotient rule for logarithms, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\log_{3}\left(\frac{1}{7}\right) &=\log_{3}\left(\frac{10}{70}\right) \\ & =\log_{3}\left(10\right)-\log_{3}\left(70\right) \\ & =u-v\end{aligned}
$$

generation.domain: Positive real arguments; common base > 0 and != 1. Numeric arguments > 1.
